question.text: A scientist is observing a bacteria through a compound microscope. For better analysis and to improve its resolving power he should. (Select the best option)

options.text: Increase the wave length of the light
Increase the refractive index of the medium between the object and objective lens
Decrease the focal length of the eye piece
Decrease the diameter of the objective lens

solution.text:
As we know resolving power P∝μsinθλ.

Therefore, as μ increases, P will increase.
